ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area covering approximately 95% of the visible fluke, with localized high-intensity (white/tan) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and along scattered surface abrasions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous black mass across both lobes; secondary high-contrast clusters located at the far-left and far-right distal tips (barnacle colonies); tertiary sparse white point-source pixels scattered across the mid-to-lower sections of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits a series of 5-7 distinct irregular peaks and valleys (medium frequency); right lobe trailing edge presents a smoother profile with lower amplitude variations, except for the extreme distal tip where barnacle encrustations create a jagged, non-organic boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing margins leading to sharply pointed, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent horizontal white linear scratch on the medial section of the left lobe; multiple fine, unaligned white linear disruptions on the upper-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal margins of both fluke tips; multiple distinct white linear rake marks/scratches across the ventral surface.
